intent: Make migrate_helium_passwords_to_basic.py actually work on the user's box: the first version handed back twice never showed the keyring dialog, and the running-Helium guard false-positived on an idle machine.
changes: `secret-tool lookup` is non-interactive: on a locked keyring it returns nothing and shows no dialog. A busctl Unlock+Prompt sequence also cannot work because Secret Service prompt objects die with the connection that created them. secretstorage keeps one D-Bus connection: get_default_collection().unlock() pops the gcr dialog and blocks until answered.

`pgrep -f /opt/helium-browser-bin` matched the invoking shell whose argv mentioned the path, so the guard reported Helium running on an idle machine; the pattern is now anchored to `^/opt/helium-browser-bin/`.
